props.gloss_en: the mishna: the wind covered it -- he is obligated to cover
R' Yochanan: they taught this [obligation] only where it again became uncovered
R' Yochanan: but if it did not again become uncovered -- he is exempt from covering
Rav Pappa: this is to say there is no rejection with regard to mitzvot
the baraita: one who slaughters and the blood was absorbed in the ground -- he is obligated to cover
there [the baraita speaks] where its mark is recognisable

supports.gloss_en: זאת אומרת -- since R' Yochanan obligates once it is uncovered again, the wind's covering did not permanently reject the mitzva

objections.gloss_en: וכי חזר ונתגלה מאי הוי? הא אידחי ליה -- and when it became uncovered again, what of it? it was already rejected [from covering when the wind covered it]
